about: Exchanges with a FHIR R4 server, in order, from a store holding none of the ids they use. Each was measured on IRIS for Health's own FHIR server (JsonAdvSQL, R4 core); targets says which servers a runner sends it to: the test FHIR server (facade), IRIS (iris), or both. {p} in a path, header or body is the run's id prefix and {P} the same in capitals (empty for the test server after its reset); {v:name}, {body:name} and {link:name} are values captured by an earlier exchange.
